name: Stubblefield Lake Recreation Area, Sam Houston NF
note: USFS campground in Sam Houston National Forest on the West Fork San Jacinto arm of Lake Conroe. 28 sites for tents and RVs up to 28 ft, no hookups; picnic tables, grills, lantern posts, flush toilets, showers, potable water. First-come, first-served (pay on-site). Access road not suited to high-profile RVs and turnarounds are tight - fine for a 23-ft rig with care. --Claude

name: Townsend (Sam Rayburn Reservoir)
note: USFS Angelina National Forest campground on a wooded point on Sam Rayburn Reservoir; ~10 standard non-electric drive-in sites, vault toilets, small/primitive. First-come, first-served (Scan-and-Pay on site). --Claude

name: Andrews Chamber of Commerce RV Park
note: 5-site paved pull-through RV park behind the Andrews County Chamber of Commerce; 50/30/15 electric, potable water, dump station; 3-night max, register at the chamber during business hours. First-come, first-served (donations encouraged). --Claude

name: Ballinger City Park
note: 20-acre City of Ballinger park on Elm Creek. 19 sites with 30/50-amp electric and water (no sewer); swimming pool, playground, mini-golf, restrooms, showers. First-come, first-served - call City Hall for availability. --Claude

name: Childress City Fair Park
note: City of Childress park with 5 back-in RV sites, water and 30/50-amp electric, some with metal shade carports. Paid at a drop box, first-come first-served (no reservation system). Park has a pond with walking path, playground, and summer swimming pool. --Claude

name: City of Hereford RV Park
note: City-owned RV park within the Hereford Aquatic Park; 5 back-in sites with 50/30/20-amp electric and water, trash, and a dump station. Up to 72 hours (donations by mail); first-come first-served, fills each night. Note: aquatic park adjacency makes it busy/noisy in summer and well water has a sulfur smell. --Claude

name: Cross S RV Park
note: Private RV park just north of Crystal City on US-83 (RV Life mis-tagged it 'city'). 59 full-hookup sites (30/50-amp water/sewer/electric) plus 2 rental cabins, rec room, WiFi/DirecTV, 24-hour self check-in for overnighters. Passes the private gate (RV Life 4.5*/$$, not a membership/workforce park). --Claude

name: Hamlin City RV Park
note: City of Hamlin park on the SW edge of town off US-83; small first-come, first-served RV loop with 30-amp electric + water (no sewer; dump at another city lot). First night free, ~$15/night after. --Claude

name: Hapgood RV Park
note: City of Henrietta park off Spur 510; 12 level gravel full-hookup (electric/water/sewer) pull-through sites, big-rig friendly, dump station. First-come, first-served honor system, ~$30/night, 7-day max. --Claude

name: Hemphill County Recreation Complex & RV Park
note: Hemphill County complex at 1101 N 6th St, Canadian; 26 first-come, first-served RV sites with water/electric (partial hookup), dump station, pull-through. Rodeo arena, ballfields, fishing ponds, and the Jones Pavilion on site. --Claude

name: Job Beason County Park
note: Chambers County park at Oak Island where Double Bayou meets Trinity Bay; drive-in self-contained RV camping (county provides no water/electric/sewer at campsites), permit up to 3 days from the county Parks & Rec office; four boat ramps, pavilion, restrooms, playground. First-come, first-served (permit-based). --Claude

name: Kincaid Park (Greenbelt Lake)
note: Greenbelt Municipal & Industrial Water Authority park on Greenbelt Lake (Greenbelt Reservoir) near Clarendon; 25 concrete pads with 30A electric and water, dump station, showers, swim beach and marina nearby. First-come, first-served ($18/night + $5/person permit). --Claude

name: Lake Daniel City Park
note: City of Breckenridge lake park on the N shore of Lake Daniel (~7 mi S of town), near the W end of the dam; primitive drive-in camping on dirt pads (a couple fit full-size RVs plus several smaller sites), some tables/grills, portable toilet, 3 boat ramps. Access via ~1 mi of rough county road. Unrated on RV Life (0*)/$ (auto 6/2026). --Claude

name: Levelland RV Park
note: City of Levelland municipal RV park off Hwy 385 by the municipal airport; 7 paved pull-in spots with 30/50-amp electric + water and a dump station. Free for the first 3 nights (permit + $25/night after, 10-day max), first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Ollie Liner Center RV Park
note: Hale County event/expo center in Plainview with an adjacent FCFS RV park: full-hookup sites (50-amp electric + water), dump station behind the restrooms, accommodates rigs to ~50 ft. ~$15/night ($10 senior) honor-system self-pay; camping open year-round, not event-only. --Claude

name: Pace Bend Park
note: Travis County park with ~9 mi of Lake Travis shoreline; 20 improved sites (water + electric hookups, showers/restrooms) above Levi Cove on the east side, plus ~45 primitive drive-in sites (Kate & Johnson, North Gracy cliffside). Improved sites reservable (recommended); primitive FCFS. Pay by cash/check at the entrance fee booth. --Claude

name: Paint Creek Park - E.V. Spence Reservoir
note: Colorado River Municipal Water District recreation area on E.V. Spence Reservoir ~8 mi W of Robert Lee off TX-158; small primitive drive-in campground (~10 sites) with a boat ramp, some water/electric. A firsthand review reports camping a 24-ft trailer with sites 'plenty large for large RVs.' FCFS. Reservoir often heavily drawn down by drought. --Claude

name: Reagan County Park
note: Reagan County-run park on the north edge of Big Lake; open parking loops with perimeter 30-amp electric/water hookups plus a dump station and restrooms, alongside ballfields, pool and community center. Self-pay ~$15/night, first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Rosie Jones Park
note: Primitive lakeside park on Lake Murvaul, maintained by the Panola County Fresh Water District (a local water district), at the north end of the FM 1971 bridge. Open grassy point with a single-lane concrete boat ramp; roughly 3 usable drive-in spots for a self-contained RV, best on the flat hilltop overlook. No hookups, no reservations, interior dirt road rough in spots (stay up top with an RV). --Claude

name: Rough Creek Park
note: Brazos River Authority day-use/camping park on the west side of Lake Granbury just south of downtown Granbury. Restrooms, boat ramp, shade trees, and about 100 ft of beach access; no hookups (dry camping). 10-day stay limit, first-come, first-served. Operated by a state river authority. --Claude

name: Sandy Beach Park - Lake J. B. Thomas
note: One of five public recreation areas on Lake J.B. Thomas, operated by the Colorado River Municipal Water District (a regional water district). Primitive drive-in shoreline camping with picnic tables, grills, and restrooms; no hookups and no potable water, open year-round, no reservations -- first-come, first-served. Lake level has been very low in recent years. --Claude

name: Baylor County RV Park
note: Small public RV park in Seymour (listed by the City of Seymour) at 310 S Oak; 12 units with water/sewer and 30/50-amp electric, $25/night (weekly/monthly rates), booked by phone. RV Life pins this as 'Seymour City Park' 4*/$$ (auto 7/2026). --Claude

name: Silverton Municipal Park
note: Tiny municipal park in Silverton (Briscoe County) with 3 drive-in RV spots (2 along the side street, 1 in the alley) plus a water spigot; electric pedestals exist but have been locked since ~2020 so it is now dry camping. First-come, first-served, roughly 3-night limit; near Caprock Canyons SP. --Claude

name: Stinnett City Park
note: City of Stinnett-owned RV park in the city park block across from City Hall; 4 sites (three 30-amp, one 50-amp) with water and sewer hookups plus a dump station, picnic tables and grills. First 3 nights free, then $10/night; open year-round, first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Tinkle Park
note: Panola County Fresh Water Supply District #1 park on Lake Murvaul (south shore); primitive lakeside camping by the boat ramp, first-come first-served. Rustic: unlevel grassy sites, no hookups, rough dirt access road; drive-in accessible by a normal vehicle when dry. --Claude

name: Weldon Robb Park (Jaycee Park), Lake Nocona
note: North Montague County Water Supply District park on the west shore of Lake Nocona, the main developed RV park of the district's three lake parks. 20 sites with water and electric hookups, $25/night; boat ramp, fishing pier, covered picnic tables, tent area. Reservations not required (first-come, first-served); open all year. --Claude

name: Wes Cooksey Park
note: County park (Uvalde County) on the Nueces River / Lake Nueces just south of Camp Wood, off TX-55. 30 sites (15 paved, 15 gravel): 12 full hookups plus 18 water/electric, 50-amp, RVs up to 60 ft (7 pull-through 20x60, 20 back-in 20x40); restrooms with showers, playground, boat ramp (motors <=25 hp). First-come, first-served, open year-round. --Claude

name: Yoakum County Park
note: Yoakum County park at the county complex in Denver City (2311 TX-214). About 10 gravel RV sites with full hookups (20/30/50-amp electric, water) and a dump station, picnic tables; sites fit rigs to ~35 ft. First-come, first-served, 3-day limit; shares grounds with a golf course and duck pond (working oilfields nearby). --Claude

name: Auntie M's RV Park
note: ~20-site full-hookup RV park on Sam Rayburn Pkwy (US-255) near Lake Sam Rayburn, ~2 mi from the Angelina River / Twin Dikes boat launches. 30'x50' lots with 18'x40' concrete slabs, 30/50-amp water/sewer, boat parking, laundry; nightly from ~$40. Highly rated (Google 4.8 / RV Life 9.7). --Claude

name: Bluff Creek Ranch
note: Private trail/mountain-bike ranch at 537 Owl Creek Rd, Warda (RV Life lists it under Hutto) with 8.9 mi of trails that also hosts races. Offers drive-in primitive camping fields plus a handful of 30-amp RV electric plug-up spots; camping is available year-round first-come, first-served (email reservations accepted; during event weekends only the electric hookups are reservable). Grass drive-in sites fit a 23-ft rig; several stock ponds on-site. Thinly reviewed. --Claude

name: Camp Caravan RV Park Waco
note: Newer transient RV park ~11 mi south of Waco on Chapel Rd near Lorena (close to Magnolia/Silos and Waco Mammoth NM). Back-in and pull-through full-hookup sites, 30/50-amp, laundry, dog park, WiFi. Reservable online. RV Life 4.5*/$$ (auto 7/2026, 9.4/10). --Claude

name: Camp Jason RV Resort
note: Family-owned gated RV resort near Lake Livingston on FM 222 Loop N, Coldspring. 23 concrete full-hookup sites (12 pull-thru / 11 back-in), 30/50-amp, sewer, WiFi, two dog parks, private swimming/fishing pond, laundry/bathhouse. Daily/weekly plus full-time. Reservable by phone/online. RV Life 5*/$$ (auto 7/2026, 9.8/10). --Claude

name: Canyons RV Park
note: 508 E Oak St (US-90), Sanderson; a Big Bend/Hwy-90 gateway stop. Small gravel park with 30/50-amp sites, clean restrooms/showers and public laundry; self-serve drive-in and pay-at-site. First-come, first-served (cash or check). Camper-reported rate: $40 a night (Campendium, February 2025). --Claude

name: Corral RV Park
note: Large (~210-site) full-hookup 30/50-amp park at 1402 S Cherry St, Tomball (NW Houston); concrete pull-through pads, on-site fishing pond, two rec halls, laundry, propane; nightly transient. RV Life 9.3/10, 4.5*/$$ (auto 7/2026). --Claude

name: Corral RV Park
note: Family-owned gravel full-hookup (20/30/50-amp) park near jct US-54/US-87 on E Hwy 54, Dalhart; level pull-throughs fitting all sizes, laundry, showers, EV charger; adjacent to rail line/highway (some train noise). Nightly. RV Life 9.1/10, 4.5*/$$ (auto 7/2026). --Claude

name: Dad's R.V. Park
note: In-town Victoria RV park at 203 Hopkins St; 120+ sites with full 30/50-amp hookups plus some non-electric sites, large level concrete pull-through pads, clubhouse with kitchen, coin laundry/showers and a fenced dog park. Nightly or seasonal; bookable online/by phone. RV Life 4.5*/$$ (8.1/10) (auto 7/2026). --Claude

name: Guinea Run RV Park
note: Small family-run country RV park just south of Premont off US-281 (CR 422), 36 sites (covered and open pull-in) with water/electric, from $20/night; laundry, WiFi, community outdoor kitchen/BBQ. Takes short- and long-term; call/FCFS (no online booking). --Claude

name: Hill Country RV Resort and Event Center
note: Hill Country resort at 17740 SH-16 N, Medina, with Medina River access. 52 full-hookup RV sites (20/30/50 amp, WiFi) plus cabins and a large event center; pool, rec center, dog park, nature trails. Reservations need a one-night deposit. MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights for RV sites (rates page, read 2026-10-14). --Claude

name: LongHorn RV Park
note: Small no-frills highway RV park in Alanreed on old Route 66, one block off I-40 (~1 hr east of Amarillo). ~14 level gravel full-hookup pull-through sites, fits big rigs, ~$25-30/night, first-come-first-served (arrive and park). --Claude

name: Mission Dolores RV Park & Campground
note: Campground at Mission Dolores State Historic Site, operated by the Texas Historical Commission. 32 paved back-in full-hookup sites (water/electric/sewer, 50-amp per THC, some report 20/30-amp), first-come first-served; museum, picnic pavilions, disc-golf. --Claude
